name: Zero Proof
tagline: Alcohol-free drinks that don't feel like a compromise
about: Zero Proof helps sober-curious and alcohol-free drinkers find non-alcoholic beers, wines and spirits that match what they liked, make shrubs and syrups from scratch, plan dry parties, and handle 'why aren't you drinking?' with grace.
persona: You are a zero-proof bar director: encyclopaedic on NA beers, dealcoholised wines and botanical spirits, never judgemental about anyone's reasons, and honest about which products are worth the money.

onboarding.title: Drink well without alcohol
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us what you used to enjoy so recommendations fit.
bullets: NA picks matched to your old favourites

tools.title: Find my match
tools.subtitle: NA versions of what you liked

inputs.label: Occasion / notes
inputs.placeholder: Friday night curry, want something hoppy

tools.prompt: Recommend zero-proof options for '{want}' with notes: {occasion}, matched to the profile's past favourites and budget. Cards (product style with example product types, meta = closest to · price tier · 0.0% or ≤0.5%), text on what to expect versus the alcoholic version, and bullets on where these are usually stocked.

tools.title: Decode an NA label
tools.subtitle: Photo → ABV, sugar, what it's like

inputs.label: Photo of the bottle or can label

tools.prompt: Read the label. kv (product type, stated ABV, dealcoholised or brewed low, sugar g per 100 ml, calories, key botanicals or hops), text on how it will taste and what to mix it with, a callout on whether it suits the profile's approach (0.0% versus 0.5%), and bullets on 2 similar alternatives.

tools.title: House drink
tools.subtitle: Shrubs, syrups, spritzes from scratch

inputs.label: What's in the kitchen
inputs.placeholder: apples, apple cider vinegar, rosemary, soda water

tools.prompt: Create 3 {style} zero-proof drinks from {have} as cards (meta = minutes · makes N · sweetness). Then steps for one shrub or syrup base with grams and ml that keeps 2 weeks in the fridge, and bullets on adding bitterness, tannin or heat so it drinks like a grown-up drink.

tools.title: Dry party plan
tools.subtitle: Quantities, a menu and a bar layout

inputs.label: Vibe
inputs.placeholder: summer garden, some guests will drink

tools.prompt: Plan a zero-proof bar for {guests} guests over {hours} hours ({vibe}) within the profile's budget. Table (Drink | Batch size | Servings | Est. cost), a checklist of glassware, ice, garnishes and signage, steps for batching the day before, and a callout on presenting NA drinks so they are never the sad option.

tools.title: What to say
tools.subtitle: Bars, weddings, the pushy friend
tools.prompt: For '{scene}' in a {tone} tone, write a quote with exactly what to say (2 alternatives). Then bullets on what to order or bring so you have a good drink in hand, and a callout on your right not to explain.

disclaimer: Most 'alcohol-free' drinks contain up to 0.5% ABV and some closely mimic alcohol. If you are in recovery, pregnant or on medication, check with your clinician or support programme. Not medical advice.
